title: SimBot Shenanigans

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Got another one logged for the feeds. Talk about a good day!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Got another one logged for the feeds. Talk about a good day!

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Interview of course. Just wrapped chatting with Alayna Nicole.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interview of course. Just wrapped chatting with Alayna Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: You've never heard of her? She's only the number one zero-g gymnast in Nivalis. Her inverted hover-bar routine qualified her for the Luna championship.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've never heard of her? She's only the number one zero-g gymnast in Nivalis. Her inverted hover-bar routine qualified her for the Luna championship.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: In the flesh. Well, momentarily. I got a transport ticket with my name on it. What do you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the flesh. Well, momentarily. I got a transport ticket with my name on it. What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: My ticket? Oh, nowhere really. I'm just headed to--hey, what's that over there? Is that Cotton Scares the horror clown?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My ticket? Oh, nowhere really. I'm just headed to--hey, what's that over there? Is that Cotton Scares the horror clown?

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Nothing, thought I saw someone. Anyway, gotta go! Lots to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing, thought I saw someone. Anyway, gotta go! Lots to do.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Oh neon lights are you from the CasterTech's union? Didn't Sec disband you guys for illegally working to increase pay to subminimal wages?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh neon lights are you from the CasterTech's union? Didn't Sec disband you guys for illegally working to increase pay to subminimal wages?

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: The Hover Derby brute? What about her? Ohh! You're a fan? Boy let me tell you, I got something you're gonna love.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Hover Derby brute? What about her? Ohh! You're a fan? Boy let me tell you, I got something you're gonna love.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Authentic jersey used in her match against the Booming Snowbirds. Can practically smell her on it. Was a brutal match. She knocked out this one defender, took the gray helmet clean off his head.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Authentic jersey used in her match against the Booming Snowbirds. Can practically smell her on it. Was a brutal match. She knocked out this one defender, took the gray helmet clean off his head.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Right?! Even a bit of blood on it. I tell yah, nothing like a good game of Hover Derby to watch people beat the bloody bits from each other.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right?! Even a bit of blood on it. I tell yah, nothing like a good game of Hover Derby to watch people beat the bloody bits from each other.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Look, something like this? I could easily get 700 Lims for. Eeeaaasssyyyy. But for you? Let's say 500.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, something like this? I could easily get 700 Lims for. Eeeaaasssyyyy. But for you? Let's say 500.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: You think you know about the SimBot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think you know about the SimBot.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Umm, no? Hahaha. Seriously? Buy it if you want it. Oh, and the price jumped. 1,000 Lims and it's yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Umm, no? Hahaha. Seriously? Buy it if you want it. Oh, and the price jumped. 1,000 Lims and it's yours.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: A smart business decision? Look, I got bills to pay like everyone else. Think I want 'Sec to come in and throw me to the wastes? Or worse, The Vents?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A smart business decision? Look, I got bills to pay like everyone else. Think I want 'Sec to come in and throw me to the wastes? Or worse, The Vents?

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Why? What's it to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why? What's it to you?

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Awww, that's so cute, and I care, really I do. Except I don't. At all. Ohhhh, what do we have for them Delilah? Nothing. We have nothing for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Awww, that's so cute, and I care, really I do. Except I don't. At all. Ohhhh, what do we have for them Delilah? Nothing. We have nothing for you.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Neither am I. I want to eat next week and with the Comms down and our ad rev next to nothing, I need this. Okay?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Neither am I. I want to eat next week and with the Comms down and our ad rev next to nothing, I need this. Okay?

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Pleasure doing business with you. Hey, if you're bored later, check out channel 37454. I'll be on the feeds at nine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pleasure doing business with you. Hey, if you're bored later, check out channel 37454. I'll be on the feeds at nine.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Maybe so, but at least I'll be able to afford some food!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe so, but at least I'll be able to afford some food!

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Managed to get a sound bite before she left! This is gonna be huge! Can't wait to see the bruise it leaves on In-Step. Those bastards have had such a run lately!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Managed to get a sound bite before she left! This is gonna be huge! Can't wait to see the bruise it leaves on In-Step. Those bastards have had such a run lately!

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: You're a true fan if you tracked me down for it. So from one to the next, I want you to have it. You know, in exchange for Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a true fan if you tracked me down for it. So from one to the next, I want you to have it. You know, in exchange for Lims.

nodes.speaker: Kai Reston
nodes.text: Why is her livelihood more important than mine? Look, buy the jersey or don't, that's where we're at.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is her livelihood more important than mine? Look, buy the jersey or don't, that's where we're at.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Another WHAT logged?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another WHAT logged?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you Kai Reston?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you Kai Reston?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who's Alayna Nicole?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who's Alayna Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you're not following her, where's your ticket to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're not following her, where's your ticket to?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you're not following her, where's your ticket to?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you're not following her, where's your ticket to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Speaking of leaving a bruise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Speaking of leaving a bruise.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually, I need to talk to you about Roxi Fynx.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually, I need to talk to you about Roxi Fynx.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually, I need to talk to you about Roxi Fynx.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually, I need to talk to you about Roxi Fynx.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yeah? Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I know about the SimBot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know about the SimBot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gnarly!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gnarly!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. I do. And I need you to scrap the scan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I do. And I need you to scrap the scan.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. I do. And I need you to scrap the scan.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. I do. And I need you to scrap the scan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would you call it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would you call it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just give me the jersey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just give me the jersey.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's a friend and you're scamming her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's a friend and you're scamming her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's a friend and you're scamming her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's a friend and you're scamming her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm a fan and you're scamming her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a fan and you're scamming her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm a fan and you're scamming her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm a fan and you're scamming her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not playing around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not playing around.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine. Here. Now give me the damn jersey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. Here. Now give me the damn jersey.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine. Here. Now give me the damn jersey.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine. Here. Now give me the damn jersey.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a grifter and you should be ashamed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a grifter and you should be ashamed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're a grifter and you should be ashamed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're a grifter and you should be ashamed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nasty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nasty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you sucked up to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you sucked up to her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you sucked up to her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you sucked up to her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you ambushed her here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you ambushed her here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't even know me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't even know me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you be so ... generous?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you be so ... generous?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would you be so ... generous?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would you be so ... generous?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Impressive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Impressive.

nodes.script:
//give player Roxi Jersey 
KaiReston.Business += 1; RoxiFynx.Friend += 1; GlobalMorality.Corp += 1; RoxiFynx.RoxiJersey = true; GlobalInventory.Lims -= KaiReston.RoxyJerseyPrice;
